title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk sebuah Barrio Sinonogan di Kotamadya Pambujan, Provinsi Samar

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1757_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitios of Canagman, Pamantangan, Cabalyanan, Nagbong, Nabaye, Ele, Amotayong, and Cagkilikili in the Municipality of Pambujan, Province of Samar, are hereby constituted into a barrio in the said municipality to be known as the barrio of Sinonogan.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
